summary: The change adds CSP frame-ancestors none and X-Frame-Options DENY to the shared HTML response helper, routes the remaining static HTML asset through it, wires deployed header probes into both deployment verifiers, and adds route/header plus Chromium sibling-origin framing regression tests.

evidence: src/http.ts lines 74-84 set content-security-policy to frame-ancestors none and x-frame-options to DENY after caller headers, so every htmlResponse is protected and cannot be overridden.
src/passport.ts lines 2872-2874 route the remaining static sign-in-buttons HTML through htmlResponse; all HTML-producing routes use that helper.
scripts/verify_framing.ts probes deployed HTML headers and is invoked by scripts/verify_deployment.ts line 39 and scripts/verify_workers.ts line 57.

tests/framing_test.ts and tests/framing_browser_test.ts cover headers and a Chromium same-site sibling-origin iframe regression with authenticated positive controls; package.json exposes test:framing.
